items.prompt: A normal sampler asks for sigma, but a model records variance 9. What standard-deviation argument corresponds to that variance?

options.text: 9, because variance and standard deviation are synonyms
options.why: Standard deviation is the square root of variance.

options.text: 81, because every parameter should be squared
options.why: The model already records the squared unit.

options.text: 3, while preserving the model mean separately
options.why: The parameter contract asks for the positive square root.

options.text: -3, because negative sigma is the standard convention
options.why: A normal standard deviation is positive.

items.explanation: Notation and API parameters can differ. Resolve whether the second parameter means variance or standard deviation before generating values.
